title: Lifting geometric points through normalized generic data
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $x\in X$, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, and $F$ a constructible sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on the small etale site of $X$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Let $Y$ be a scheme, $
u:Y	o X$ an integral morphism [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], $K$ a field, $a$ a $\kappa(x)$-algebra structure on $K$ making $K$ a finite-dimensional $\kappa(x)$-module [def-weil-residue-field], and $g:\operatorname{Spec}K	o Y$ a morphism satisfying $g\circ
u$ in diagrammatic order, namely $
u\circ g=\iota_x\circ\operatorname{Spec}(a)$, where $\iota_x:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(x)	o X$ is the canonical residue-field morphism. Let $M$ be a finite $\Lambda$-module and $M_Y$ its constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Assume that the adjunction unit $M_Y	o g_*g^*M_Y$ is an isomorphism and that $g^*
u^*F\cong g^*M_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. Then for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and every geometric point $s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega	o X$ with image $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point], there exists $w:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega	o\operatorname{Spec}K$ such that $
u\circ g\circ w=s$.

proof.text: Write s as Spec(phi) followed by the residue-field inclusion using Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField; the underlying-point equality identifies its residue field with kappa(x). Give Omega the algebra structure phi.hom.toAlgebra. The finite extension K/kappa(x) is algebraic. IsAlgClosed.lift gives a kappa(x)-algebra hom e:K -> Omega. Take w=Spec(e). Rewrite using the supplied normalization square, Spec.map_comp_assoc and e.commutes to prove w followed by g and nu equals s.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09Z6, proof of (1), finite extension K/kappa(x) and lift of the geometric point; explicit Mathlib proof by P2.

lean.statement:
theorem normalized_generic_data_lifts
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (_hF : Scheme.IsConstructibleEtaleModuleSheaf F) (x : X)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X) (_hν : IsIntegralHom ν)
    (K : Type u) (_ : Field K) (g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Y)
    (a : Algebra (X.residueField x) K)
    (ha : @Module.Finite (X.residueField x) K _ _ a.toModule)
    (hcomp : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (@algebraMap (X.residueField x) K _ _ a)) ≫
      X.fromSpecResidueField x = g ≫ ν)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (_hM : Finite M)
    (_hu : IsIso ((upperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).unit.app
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)))
    (_he : Nonempty
      ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
        ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj F) ≅
       (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
      ((Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω X) s).1 = x →
        ∃ w : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec (.of K), w ≫ g ≫ ν = s

statement_change.old_statement: Given the normalized generic data produced by lem-weil-pbc-constructible-module-normalized-generic-data, every geometric point over x factors through Spec K.
statement_change.what: The old signature permitted unrelated g and x. It omitted both the finite residue-field algebra and the normalization square. Retain these data from the construction rather than asserting lifts for arbitrary g. The original statement is false on a disjoint union of two field spectra with the zero sheaf.
